cases.customer_question: How should a product based on a qualified Controller Subsystem and a qualified host-stack Component be qualified without requiring additional testing?
question_variants: Can a Controller Subsystem and Component be combined without testing?
How do I qualify a module with a separately qualified host stack?
Should I reference both the Controller Subsystem and BLE Solution QDIDs?
Can overlapping Core Layers be reused without generating tests?
What is the best qualification path for a Controller Subsystem plus host stack design?
cases.actual_issue: A qualified Controller Subsystem and a qualified BLE host-stack Component contained overlapping Core Layer coverage. Under the new Qualification Workspace process, combining both references could trigger Consistency Check-driven lower-layer test requirements.
cases.plain_english_explanation: The customer wanted to reuse existing Bluetooth qualifications instead of running new tests. Two different qualified designs covered some of the same Bluetooth layers. Under the new qualification system, referencing both can create extra test requirements even if the functionality is already covered elsewhere.
cases.consultant_answer: The consultant initially believed overlapping layers could simply be excluded during design creation. After evaluating Qualification Workspace behavior and Consistency Check processing, the consultant determined that overlapping Core Layer references could generate lower-layer test requirements. Analysis showed that the BLE Solution qualification already provided equivalent ICS coverage for the needed functionality. Therefore, referencing only the BLE Solution qualification achieved the same result while avoiding unnecessary testing and qualification complexity.
cases.decision_logic: If a referenced qualification already provides the required ICS and Core Layer coverage, adding another qualification with overlapping layers creates unnecessary Consistency Check evaluation. Avoiding redundant layer references prevents generation of additional test requirements.
cases.final_recommendation: Use the BLE Solution qualification as the sole reference design and avoid combining it with the overlapping Controller Subsystem reference when equivalent ICS coverage is already present.
cases.risk_if_done_wrong: Combining overlapping qualified designs can trigger lower-layer test requirements in the Qualification Workspace. Existing module-vendor test evidence may not satisfy the generated requirements, resulting in unnecessary testing effort, qualification rework, and schedule delay.
